svg.aria-label: Architecture and workflow: you ask your AI client, which calls the five tools of the Gatewise MCP server. The server drives a sandbox today a local process and next a Docker container per run, a real browser and a judge, remembers what it learns in an authorization graph, signs a passport, opens a GitHub pull request, and you click Merge. Planned items are dashed.
svg.text: Brings its own model and key
Runs on your machine. No model inside.
Engine: scan, locate, verify, court, passport
Where the app is attacked and the fix is judged
A public record of every passport
Blocks the merge on a leak
